title: Pathophysiology of Circadian Rhythm Delayed Sleep Wake Phase Disorder
official: Pathophysiology of Circadian Rhythm Delayed Sleep Wake Phase Disorder
summary: The goal of this study is to understand factors that contribute to delayed sleep wake phase disorder (DSWPD). The investigators will examine whether patients with DSWPD exhibit alterations in circadian rhythms and sensitivity to light compared to healthy controls. The investigators will also test a new method of predicting circadian rhythms form a blood sample.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Delayed sleep wake phase disorder diagnosis
* Altitude history: currently residing at Denver altitude or higher
* BMI normal to moderately overweight

Exclusion Criteria:

* Recent medical condition
* Psychiatric disorder
* Sleep disorder
* Medication use
